title: Customer Gateway: Dedicated Capacity SLA Assessment Proforma
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable proforma used by PM and concierge to assess enterprise dedicated capacity requests. Scope: intake questionnaire, triage rubric, estimated GPU class mapping, SLA target proposal, recommended scaling policy, canned customer communications. Not covering procurement/legal contract finalization. Outcome: a one-page assessment that can be completed in 30-45 minutes and yields a recommended SLA band, GPU family, daily throughput reserve, and fallback plan.
acceptance_criteria: A concise intake form (PDF + internal form) that captures throughput pattern, P95 latency goal, burst tolerance, data isolation needs, and compliance constraints
Triage rubric that maps workload fingerprint to GPU class recommendations (A100/H100/RTX) and preflight sizing heuristics
SLA target suggestions (latency and availability) tied to capacity bands and expected cost delta
Template can be completed by PM/Solutions in 30-45 minutes and includes next-step decision tree
Stakeholder sign-off flow defined (eng reliability, sales, legal when required)
preflight_checklist: Confirm customer has completed intake questionnaire
Request sample QPS traces and 95th/99th latency targets
Obtain model family, quantization and KV cache expectations
Schedule quick runbook review with SRE if SLA is P0/P1 high-impact

decision_log: Use conservative default P95 latency SLO buckets: <100ms, 100-250ms, 250-500ms, >500ms
Default GPU-family recommendation based on token throughput and model size rather than model name to avoid hard mappings
Adopt two-tier scaling policy: steady reserved capacity + burst credits with automated fallback to lower-cost model variant under contention
Require SRE sign-off for any SLA that targets availability >99.95% or P95 latency <=100ms
outreach_notes: Pilot customers: Acme AI (contact: emma@acme.ai), FinLedger (contact: r.cho@finledger.com), MedQuery (contact: dr.lee@medquery.health)
Concierge script created for intake calls (link in Drive)
risk_assessment: High cost sensitivity for customers with large token volumes — include clear cost delta estimates in proposal
Model behavior variability may require larger than anticipated KV cache — flag as potential increase to reserved memory footprint
Regional capacity constraints could force suboptimal GPU family fallback; include explicit customer-facing fallback plan
SLA overcommit risk if we do not provision adequate headroom for burst patterns
estimated_cost_impact: Estimated incremental cost to serve (monthly): $3k - $45k depending on GPU family and 99th percentile burst profile. Provide tiered quote in proforma.
